caption:
How I made my first $100 on YouTube.

When Shorts came out, you could post 100 a day. I had nothing else to do, so I did.

About a thousand views each. Around 100K views a day. Ten days later, AdSense paid me my first $100.

Not from a client. From YouTube.

Volume got me here.

Comment VOLUME if you're posting every day right now.
